A helmet with your own paint, on top of the game's: Character > Helmet. \"Template\" saves the shell unfolded into a disc (1024 x 1024): the centre is the top of the helmet, the front is at the bottom of the image, left and right are the driver's; write with the top of the letters towards the centre. Paint over it, then \"My image…\".

In game, it is sold at the CARDINAL shop, and the other players see it. Each player can also buy the others' helmets. The two preview views (3/4 front, 3/4 back) show your paint. \"Remove\" deletes your image.
A square image is best: it is brought to 1024 x 1024. Transparency is ignored: the whole image is painted on.
